scan_order_mapping_rule: At sequence index seq, activate heat set set_body_heat_{track:02d}, where track = scan_order[seq].
load_lifecycle_rule: Each scan step creates/activates one body heat flux load on the target track set; the load is inactive/deactivated outside its own scan step.
cool_step_rule: Each scan step is followed by one cooling step with no active body heat flux.
final_cooling_rule: After the last scan/cool pair, append one 1200-second step_final_cooling with all heat loads deactivated. Final stress evaluation should use the end of this step.
required_user_confirmation: Confirm exact Abaqus load type: BodyHeatFlux or equivalent.
Confirm load magnitude is inherited from load_body_hflux_00.
Confirm scan step time period is inherited from step_scan_00.
Confirm cool step time period is inherited from step_cool_00.
Confirm final cooling step should inherit the cooling template procedure type and use a duration of 1200 seconds.
Confirm track region objects are in rootAssembly.sets or model.rootAssembly.sets.
Confirm all set_body_heat_XX names exist for each N.
